blocks.md: **a+b without +: XOR adds ignoring carries; AND<<1 IS the carries. Iterate until carry zero.**

blocks.label: LC371 getSum
blocks.py:
# no signed-overflow UB - translate directly with care for negatives
a, b = 5, 3
while b:
    carry = a & b            # carries
    a = a ^ b                # partial sum
    b = carry << 1           # shift carries left

blocks.md: **Signed-left-shift of negative is UB in standard C++** — cast to unsigned before shifting. Interviewers probe exactly this footnote.

blocks.label: Single Number II (LC137) ones/twos automaton
blocks.py:
ones = twos = 0
for x in nums:
    ones = (ones ^ x) & ~twos
    twos = (twos ^ x) & ~ones
# answer = ones

blocks.title: Trace: one bit-column fed x=1 three times

blocks.label: Divide Two Integers (LC29) skeleton
blocks.py:
sign = -1 if (a < 0) ^ (b < 0) else 1
a, b = abs(a), abs(b)
q = 0
while a >= b:
    tmp, mul = b, 1
    while a >= tmp << 1: tmp <<= 1; mul <<= 1
    a -= tmp; q += mul
q *= sign

blocks.label: subsets via masks (vs recursion)

chain.a: Common prefix of m and n survives; everything lower gets wiped by some carried boundary. Shift both right until equal, shift back. O(31).
Store prev^next in one field; navigate with partner pointer. Curiosity gold, production poison — address-computation UB + GC hostility; say both.
Need ALL subsets materialized/indexed or memo keyed BY subset — mask doubles as hash key. Recursion wins when pruning early exits exist.
